Komi-Permyak

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian судно (sudno).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsudno/, [ˈsudno̞]
  • Hyphenation: суд‧но

Noun

[edit]

су́дно • (súdno)

  1. ship, vessel

Russian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Old East Slavic судьно (sudĭno), from Proto-Slavic *sǫdьno. Cognates include сосуд, посуда, судок. Ultimately from *som- + *dʰeh₁- + *-os.

The nautical meaning is a late calque from French vaisseau.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈsudnə]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

су́дно • (súdno) n inan (genitive су́дна, nominative plural суда́, genitive plural судо́в, relational adjective судово́й, diminutive судёнышко)

  1. ship, vessel
    Synonym: кора́бль (koráblʹ)
